module_summary: Sequential multiplier: shifts operands through state machine (Idle/Run/Finish) accumulating partial products.

anchors.name: m
anchors.why: Controls three-state multiplication sequence: Idle, Running, Finish.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start signal triggers state transition from Idle to Running.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Holds and shifts multiplier a during computation.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Holds and shifts multiplicand b during computation.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Counts bits processed from 0 to 16 to complete multiplication.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Completion detector: triggers Finish when k reaches 16.

anchors.name: t
anchors.why: Conditional accumulation result based on y[0].

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: Done signal output set in Finish state.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy flag output set when in Running state.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Input operand A multiplied with B.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Input operand B multiplied with A.

groups.name: State Machine
groups.description: FSM managing multiplication phases: Idle receives operands, Running processes bits, Finish outputs result.

groups.name: Datapath
groups.description: Accumulates product with partial sums and shifts operands right/left.

groups.name: Timing & Control
groups.description: Counts 16 bits and triggers completion flag to advance state machine.

groups.name: Status & Handshake
groups.description: Done and busy status outputs for external synchronization.
